title: Communication Dispatcher Service State
description:
The manager in the middle of the star. Decides what to do next about an ongoing
exchange, does it, and takes the result back. (Runtimes: node; IDs: communication-dispatcher)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

instruction.description: Sent as the opening of the question. Not a system message: the decide pipeline may hold something that already has one, or may not be a model at all

states.description: "name" or { name, describe }. The enum next is drawn from

stateFrom.description: Dotted path to the current state in the input

decide.description: The pipeline that asks the model

maxContextChars.description: Bound on the input shown to the model. 0 = no bound

lastAction / lastReason / lastNext.description: Read-only: what it decided, and why
